en.headline: LCSD books Charles Ng saxophone recital at City Hall in October
en.dek: Tickets at $220 went on sale for the 8 October concert in the Hong Kong Artists series, which includes two Asian premieres and a new work with composer Charles Kwong.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department said Hong Kong saxophonist Charles Ng will give a recital at 8pm on 8 October at the Theatre of Hong Kong City Hall, joined by pianist Annie Yuen, as part of the department’s Hong Kong Artists series.

The department said the first half of the programme is built around narrative works, including Chen Gang’s Sunshine Over Tashkurgan, Paule Maurice’s Tableaux de Provence, Gerald Preinfalk’s Little Bitter Sweet Symphony in its Asian premiere, and Piet Swerts’ Klonos.

The second half includes Steve Reich’s New York Counterpoint, Miguel Farías’s Cuaderno de la Pampa in its Asian premiere, and Celestial Architecture, a world premiere written with Hong Kong composer Charles Kwong. Ng is a member of the Vienna-based quintet Five Sax and teaches at the Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts.
Tickets priced at $220 are on sale through URBTIX. Telephone bookings are available on 3166 1288. The Leisure and Cultural Services Department is presenting the concert.

zh.headline: 康文署十月大會堂呈獻吳漢紳色士風演奏會
zh.dek: 「香港藝術家」系列演奏會定於10月8日晚上8晈在香港大會堂劇院舉行，票價220元已於城市售票網開售，節目包括兩首亞洲首演及一首世界首演。
body: 康樂及文化事務署公布，香港色士風演奏家吳漢紳將於10月8日晚上8晈在香港大會堂劇院舉行演奏會，與鋼琴家袁桉頡合作，屬署方「香港藝術家」系列節目。
康文署表示，上半場偏重敘事性作品，包括陳鋼《陽光照耀在塔什庫爾干》、莫利斯《普羅旺斯風情畫》、普賴因法克《糖衣苦果小交響曲》（亞洲首演）及斯韋爾茨《激變》。
下半場包括萊許《紐約對位》、法里亞斯《潘帕草原手記》（亞洲首演），以及吳漢紳與本地作曲家鄴展維共同創作的《天穹構築》（世界首演）。吳漢紳為維也納色士風五重奏Five Sax成員，現任教於香港演藝學院。
票價220元，已於城市售票網發售，電話購票可致電3166 1288。節目由康樂及文化事務署主辦。
